rootCauses.septDRIVER_ASSIGNEDStall: automation tapped 'My trips' expecting a top-level button; it is a drawer item (driver_shell_view.dart) — the harness never opened the drawer
rootCauses.offerSubmitMiss: 'Submit offer' heading is a non-clickable View sibling of the real Button; generic tap hit the heading
rootCauses.driverRatingColdStart: emulator app cold-restarted during rate navigation; form dump showed 'Signing you in…' splash — recovered via reauth + re-nav
rootCauses.run9Crash: adb 'uiautomator dump' exit 137 when the running harness and a manual dump collided on the same device — driver-progression relaunch already races it; fixed with dump retries + fewer concurrent polls

limitations: proof is segmented across 3 runs of one ride, not one uninterrupted run — harness infrastructure (adb/uiautomator races) remains fragile; app code untouched
driver discovery asserted via visible 'Respond' action (open-ride cards merge a11y to 'Respond to ride request' only); backend offer snapshot ties it to the fresh rideId
no production data, deploys, or cloud config touched; all rides are staging test data left in terminal RIDE_CLOSED state
